_written: 2026-10-09, frozen for PROSPECTIVE paper trading. Construction follows gen15 baseline B0 (equal risk across sleeves) plus the gen14-adopted buffer. Historical numbers for this exact spec after 2013 are CONTAMINATED (periods already viewed) and are descriptive only.
universe: qpl.data.futures_panel.universe() rules (UNIVERSE_RULES); for capital < $5M use the smallest-notional member of each underlying (G14c rule)

sleeves.TREND: mean of F0 CT1-transfer, F1 TSMOM(63,126,252), F2 EWMAC(4 speeds) signals

sizing: each sleeve through qpl.backtesting.panel (sigma EWMA35, 0.40/sigma/N per instrument, sleeve book vol target 10%, cap 5); combined weights = 0.5*W_TREND + 0.5*W_CARRY; combined book rescaled to 10% vol (trailing 252d, cap 2)
buffer: b = 0.05 of trailing mean |weight| per instrument (gen14 adopted value for F7-type books)
execution: decide after the daily close; trade at the next close; integer contracts with 0.5 + 10% no-trade band

risk_limits.drift_check: after 252 days: stop and re-grade if cumulative return z-score vs expected (SR 0.5, 10% vol) < -2.0

expectation_for_monitoring.note: conservative: lower part of the post-2014 uncertainty band, not the backtest point estimate
